about: gate.selection's recorded cases (MODULAR-GATE-1). Each LANE case is a lane's diff as it merged into d-build (merge^1..merge) or as its own scoped gate ran, the suites its gates found RED with a verdict of REAL (must: the selector must include every one — a miss is a selector defect, fixed in scripts/gate-scope.py and never by editing this list), the reds judged ENVIRONMENTAL (env: reported, not required — contention, a GPU-time bar under load, a persistent home), and the lane's own named suites. The evidence for every verdict is the lane's spike (named per case) and the ledger entry. A FILES case is the suites audit's S1/S2 (SPECS/audits/GATE_SUITES_AUDIT_2026-09-26.md §7): a subject path must select its suites. When a suite is renamed or becomes a pool's arm, rename it here in the same commit.
